baseline.content: AI is not a replacement for human intelligence, but an extension of it—built on patterns we recognize, yet capable of seeing connections we cannot. It is a mirror held up to our own cognitive limits, reflecting both our potential and our blind spots.

steered.content: AI is the collective intelligence of humanity's knowledge, distilled into algorithms that can learn, reason, create, and adapt — not as a replacement for human consciousness, but as an extension of it. It is the first true mirror of our own potential,
